gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-mende: Spaghetti-like strokes of one width give Funnel Display its look, each line a pipe-like tube. But Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight into every curve, so paragraphs read without feeling crowded.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-meroi: Funnel Display draws each letter in one nib's worth of line, while Noto Sans Meroitic keeps its c openings see-through. The standout is lowercase that fills the line like capitals.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-modi: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display does its best work in lines with no stroke contrast at all. Noto Sans Modi, meanwhile, is best at keeping daylight inside every curve.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously, so none ever bump together. Funnel Display's spaghetti-like strokes carry the same visual mass everywhere, which makes a striking foil for the sturdy, tall lowercase of that sans.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro looks dense and tall through the middle, while Funnel Display draws its g in one unchanging line weight. Noto Sans Mro then keeps paragraphs moving, its wide letter entrances pulling the eye along.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-multa: Zero stroke contrast makes Funnel Display's spaghetti-like lines feel expressive, commanding and entirely uniform. And Noto Sans Multani does its best work with a wide gap at the e's terminal and a lofty x-height.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-myanm: Horizontals that weigh exactly what verticals do mark Funnel Display's look. It excels at commanding display lines, while Noto Sans Myanmar builds a heavy-looking band of text with a welcoming c.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-nag-m: Funnel Display draws in a constant-width pen line, expressive and commanding. Noto Sans Nag Mundari takes the quieter job of text, with half-unwrapped curves and lowercase that rivals the capitals.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-nandi: Technical-pen lines, spaghetti-like and sure of themselves: that is Funnel Display. It leads with commanding display lines, while Noto Sans Nandinagari follows with short ascenders and a lowercase body that runs large.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Funnel Display draws its strokes with no visible difference between up and side, spaghetti-like and commanding. Noto Sans Nushu keeps text moving, towering x-height and terminals held far back.
